assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are maintainer-provided provisional rough geometry, not official red lines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, partitions, figures, and location-sensitive strategies require coordinated recalculation when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, buildings, utilities, fire, flood, and engineering constraints are absent.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, density, setback, demolition, bridge, tunnel, utility capacity, feasibility, investment, or approval conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Events, councils, sandboxes, and service operators are proposed governance prototypes.
assumptions.impact: They are not confirmed government schedules, procurement, policy, finance, or operating commitments.
